message.reasoning:
I am reviewing the Monopoly game state to determine my next move.

I am p2 with $1711 and a pink monopoly at three hotels. Player 1 has $966 and owns light blue, brown, and dark blue properties with hotels. I have two get-out-of-jail cards.

Player 1 has heavily mortgaged properties including oranges, yellows, greens, railroads, and utilities. I am calculating the next possible landing spaces from ST_JAMES_PLACE.

No rent is due on the next roll. All spaces from St. James Place are either mortgaged, owned by me, or landing spaces like Free Parking and Chance. I will not pass GO this turn.

I can afford the hotel rent on Park Place but not Boardwalk. Neither is reachable this turn. Player 1 cannot land on my pink properties either, since the maximum roll from Pacific Avenue is only twelve spaces.

Unmortgaging either property would cost more than the rent they would generate. I will end my turn.

I am reconsidering whether to sell a pink hotel now. I recall that hotels sell for half the purchase price, so each would return about fifty dollars. I had previously decided against pre-selling to keep both hotels intact.

I am reconsidering the exact mechanics of selling a hotel. The game engine's "sell_houses_or_hotel" tool might convert the hotel back into four houses rather than returning cash. I need to verify this before deciding whether to sell.

I now believe selling a hotel converts it to four houses and returns fifty dollars. A full pink strip of one hotel plus four houses would therefore yield two hundred fifty dollars. That matches my earlier assumption.

Selling one hotel plus four houses returns two hundred fifty dollars, still short of the three hundred ninety dollars needed to cover Boardwalk. Two full pink strips would yield about five hundred dollars and leave a small surplus. I will not pre-sell now because Boardwalk is not reachable this turn, and selling buildings permanently reduces my rent pressure. I can sell when I actually land there. Player 1 has only nine hundred sixty-six dollars, so a second pink hotel hit would force them to liquidate. I am also checking the liquidation value of their light blue hotels.
